definition: Per-sample aggregate covariance in (full E edge amplitudes, C selected closure phases). The optimal_singlecopy and promoted_singlecopy entries share the same POVM hash at every sample.
finite_block_caveat: The finite-n_s covariance is obtained by inflating the QLAN covariance with a universal factor calibrated at one 655-nm near-transit working point; it is not a per-bin exact finite-copy POVM.
